searchText: Question to all Core Devs... Are we still in the Beacon Chain phase of the Ethereum 2.0 upgrade? yes and no. the beacon chain is live. next milestone after the Altair staking upgrade is turning off PoW. Eth2 is deprecated nomenclature Good to know. Thanks Evan.
